```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format data
df_long = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago", "New York", "Los Angeles", "Chicago"],
    "temperature": [32, 72, 25, 35, 75, 28]
})

# Reshape from long to wide format
df_wide = df_long.pivot(index="date", columns="city", values="temperature")

print(df_wide)
```
